text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager - billing.token-counter detected token_count drift in eu-west-1, severity: medium. triggered overage_flags for 3 accounts. paging oncall.

alex: grabbing logs now, seeing counts jump ~28% at 02:03 UTC

maya: I'm oncall — joining. any customer visible errors? ping @billing-sre

chris: alerting: customers cst-112, cst-901, cst-342 flagged for suspected double-counts. UI shows spikes in usage dashboard

alex: possible emitter retry loop. consumer lag spikes + dropped acks. snippet:
```
EMITTER WARN retrying message id=abc123 attempts=4
consumer_offset: 345678 -> 345681(dup)
```

maya: good catch. throttling emitter retries in eu-west-1 now (rolling config patch)

billing-sre: applied patch to emitter, rolling restart token-counter pods (3/3)

alex: after restart, counts back to baseline within two windows. running recon to estimate duplicate tokens and mark for backfill

maya: action list: 1) hold overage flags (suppress notifications) 2) run dedupe recon 3) compute customer exposure 4) notify CSM if >$50 delta

jamie: will stand up incident bridge and message CSMs for cst-901 and cst-112. drafting message now :writing_hand:

chris: re-run of reconciliation script started: `/opt/scripts/recon_token_dupes --since 02:00Z --region eu-west-1`

alex: quick metric: token_emit_rate spike at 02:03 -> +32%, error rate unchanged. looks like duplicate emit, not new traffic

billing-sre: recon initial pass found ~12k duplicate tokens across the 3 accounts. estimating potential charge delta ~ $18. suppressing billing flags and queuing automated credit for next billing cycle

maya: being conservative — will keep a 6h observation window before automated credits. will post incident summary and intercept any customer notices

jamie: CSMs notified for two highest-impact customers. template: "We detected an internal metering duplication; we are reversing erroneous counts and will credit your account if applicable." :thumbsup:

chris: closing immediate pager. leaving follow-up tasks: postmortem, telemetry alert tuning (avoid noisy retries), add dedupe in ingestion pipeline

incident-bot: incident auto-update: status=mitigated, severity=medium, incident_id=INC-3098765432

maya: thanks team. will update timeline and open postmortem ticket. :white_check_mark:
